conditions: Not in OTC Monograph M020. Permitted in the US only in specific products approved by the FDA through a new drug application. First: L'Oreal Anthelios SX (2% avobenzone, 2% ecamsule, 10% octocrylene cream), NDA 21-502, approved 2006-07-21.
source: FDA approval letter, NDA 21-502 (Anthelios SX), L'Oreal USA Products, Inc.
